title: A Fan Replays 'Kingdom Hearts' and Misses Final Fantasy Friends
summary:
The video game website Kotaku is replaying the whole 'Kingdom Hearts' series over one year. The next big game, 'Kingdom Hearts IV,' is expected in about a year.

'Kingdom Hearts' mixes Disney characters, like Donald Duck and Goofy, with heroes from the 'Final Fantasy' games. The main hero is a boy named Sora.

In a new post, a writer looks back at the first game. As a kid, the writer did not know some characters came from 'Final Fantasy.' Now they notice a lot more.

On Sora's home, Destiny Islands, his friends Tidus, Wakka and Selphie are younger than in their own games. They use playground versions of their weapons. Tidus has a wooden practice sword, and Selphie swings a jump rope!

The writer says 'Final Fantasy' characters show up less and less in later games. They wonder if newer 'Final Fantasy' heroes might appear in 'Kingdom Hearts IV.'
why_it_matters: Kids who play games can think about which characters make a crossover game fun.
